QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Round Up
QuestInfo.0: You've lured the monster horde all the way to Grim Vale. Now there's nowhere to hide. Is there a way to defeat all these monsters in one go?!
QuestInfo.1: You've lured the monster horde all the way to Grim Vale. Now there's nowhere to hide. Is there a way to defeat all these monsters in one go?!
QuestInfo.2: With a sound like thunder, an avalanche crashes down the mountainside, burying the monster army and filling the valley with a snowy fog. That's when the giant silhouette of the monster the town has been dreading appears.
